note: The Game Bakers' free DLC On the Trail: Deep Water for Cairn, out 29 Oct (Steam DLC page 4487450, read 07:35Z): 3 new climbing spots (Haken and Ruka cliffs over water, Lamu climbing gym), water soloing (falls into water have no consequence), play as Aava or Marco incl. Kami free roam. Platforms Steam and PS5 per the trailer's end card. Footage: the DLC's own reveal trailer (Steam), DLC section 22.9 to 40.6 s only (the first 20 s carry press quotes and scores); its own music under the cut. v2 (director FIX on v1): opens on the climber at sunset for the grid tile; gym shots framed on the climber, clear of the UP'n Coffee sign.
block_ok: Lamu climbing-gym shots (trailer 30.4 to 36.25 s): frames checked at 5 fps, flat low-poly walls and holds, straight shading edges, no decode damage
